verifications.claim: The CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) is a real-time market index.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'up-to-the-minute market estimate of expected volatility that is calculated by using real-time S&P 500®Index (SPX) option bid/ask quotes'; R3: 'Wall Street’s real-time gauge'; R4: 'In real-time, it represents the market’s expectations'; R6: 'calculated and disseminated on a real-time basis'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly describe VIX as real-time.

verifications.claim: The CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) represents the market's expectation of 30-day forward-looking volatility of the S&P 500® Index (SPX).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'based on the prices of a basket of S&P 500 Index options with 30 days to expiration'; R2: 'constant, 30-day measure of the expected volatility'; R4: 'market’s expectations for volatility over the coming 30 days'; R5: 'constant, 30-day expected volatility'; R6: '30-day forward-looking volatility'; R7: 'near-term volatility conveyed by S&P 500 Index®(SPX) option prices'
verifications.reasoning: Direct matches across sources confirm 30-day forward-looking SPX volatility expectation.

verifications.claim: The VIX is calculated using SPX option prices.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'based on the prices of a basket of S&P 500 Index options'; R2: 'using real-time S&P 500®Index (SPX) option bid/ask quotes'; R4: 'based on the prices of near-term S&P 500 options'; R5: 'based on S&P 500® Index options'; R6: 'derived from S&P 500 options'; R7: 'conveyed by S&P 500 Index®(SPX) option prices'
verifications.reasoning: All listed sources explicitly state calculation uses SPX options.

verifications.claim: The VIX generally has an inverse relationship with the S&P 500.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'A rising VIX indicates... more volatile... A falling VIX... trade more quietly'; R4: 'inversely related to the S&P 500'; R5: 'inverse relationship with the S&P 500 Index'; R7: 'historically strong inverse relationship with the S&P 500® Index'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm general inverse relationship.

verifications.claim: The VIX uses a 30-day, constant, weighted measure of SPX options with Friday expirations.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Only SPX options with Friday expirations are used... weighted to yield a constant, 30-day measure of the expected volatility of the S&P 500 Index'
verifications.reasoning: R2 precisely matches all elements: 30-day constant weighted measure, Friday SPX options.
